name.km: អាម៉ុកត្រី

recipes.description: Cambodia's national dish: a fragrant, mousse-like steamed fish curry set with coconut and yellow kroeung in banana leaf.

instructions.text: Pound the yellow kroeung to a very smooth paste.
instructions.textKm: បុកគ្រឿងលឿងឱ្យល្អិតៗ។

instructions.text: Whisk the kroeung with coconut milk, egg, fish sauce and palm sugar until thick and creamy.
instructions.textKm: កូរគ្រឿងជាមួយទឹកដូង ពងមាន់ ទឹកត្រី និងស្ករត្នោត ឱ្យក្រាស់និងរលោង។
instructions.tip: Add coconut milk gradually so the mixture stays emulsified and silky.
instructions.tipKm: ដាក់ទឹកដូងបន្តិចម្ដងៗ ដើម្បីឱ្យល្បាយនៅរលោងស្អិតគ្នា។

instructions.text: Fold the sliced fish through the mixture.
instructions.textKm: បញ្ចូលសាច់ត្រីហាន់ ហើយលាយចូលគ្នាស្រួលបួល។

instructions.text: Line banana-leaf cups with soft leaves and fill with the fish mixture.
instructions.textKm: តម្រៀបស្លឹកចេកក្នុងពែង បន្ទាប់មកដាក់សាច់ត្រីដែលលាយរួច។

instructions.text: Steam over medium heat 20–25 minutes until set like a soft custard.
instructions.textKm: ចំហុយដោយភ្លើងមធ្យម ២០–២៥ នាទី រហូតទាល់តែកក ដូចសង់ខ្យាទន់។

instructions.text: Top with coconut cream and shredded kaffir lime leaf; serve with rice.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់ខ្ទិះដូងពីលើ និងស្លឹកក្រូចសើច។ បរិភោគជាមួយបាយ។

recipes.descriptionKm: ម្ហូបជាតិកម្ពុជា — ការីត្រីចំហុយក្នុងស្លឹកចេក ឈ្ងុយឈ្ងប់ ផ្សំជាមួយទឹកដូងនិងគ្រឿងលឿង។

name.km: ឡុកឡាក់

recipes.description: Cubes of seared marinated beef tossed in a tangy sauce, served over lettuce and tomato with a black-pepper-lime dip.

instructions.text: Marinate the beef cubes in garlic, oyster sauce, soy, ketchup and palm sugar for 20 minutes.
instructions.textKm: ប្រឡាក់សាច់គោដុំ ជាមួយខ្ទឹមស ទឹកអយស្ទ័រ ស៊ីអ៊ីវ អ៊ីខាប់ និងស្ករត្នោត រយៈពេល ២០ នាទី។

instructions.text: Make the dip: mix lime juice with salt and cracked Kampot black pepper.
instructions.textKm: ធ្វើទឹកជ្រលក់៖ លាយទឹកក្រូចឆ្មារ ជាមួយអំបិល និងម្រេចខ្មៅកំពតបុក។

instructions.text: Sear the beef in a screaming-hot wok in batches until browned but still pink inside.
instructions.textKm: ឆាសាច់គោក្នុងខ្ទះក្ដៅខ្លាំង ជាដំណាក់ៗ ឱ្យខាងក្រៅលឿង តែខាងក្នុងនៅផ្កាឈូក។
instructions.tip: High heat and small batches give a good sear without overcooking.
instructions.tipKm: ភ្លើងខ្លាំង និងឆាម្ដងបន្តិចៗ ដើម្បីសាច់គោក្រៀមខាងក្រៅ តែមិនឆ្អិនពេក។

instructions.text: Arrange lettuce, tomato and sliced onion on a plate and pile the beef on top.
instructions.textKm: រៀបចានដោយដាក់សាឡាត់ ប៉េងប៉ោះ និងខ្ទឹមបារាំងហាន់ បន្ទាប់មកដាក់សាច់គោពីលើ។

instructions.text: Serve with rice, a fried egg, and the black-pepper-lime dip.
instructions.textKm: បរិភោគជាមួយបាយ ពងមាន់ចៀន និងទឹកម្រេចក្រូចឆ្មារ។

recipes.descriptionKm: សាច់គោកាត់ជាដុំ ប្រឡាក់និងឆាជាមួយទឹកជ្រលក់ឆ្ងាញ់ បរិភោគជាមួយសាឡាត់ ប៉េងប៉ោះ និងទឹកម្រេចក្រូចឆ្មារ។

name.km: ប្រហុកខ្ទិះ

recipes.description: A rich coconut, pork and fermented-fish dip eaten with a big platter of raw vegetables.

instructions.text: Fry the red kroeung in coconut cream until the oil splits and it is fragrant.
instructions.textKm: ឆាគ្រឿងក្រហមជាមួយខ្ទិះដូង រហូតទាល់តែប្រេងបែក ហើយឈ្ងុយ។

instructions.text: Add the ground pork and cook until browned.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់សាច់ជ្រូកកិន ហើយឆារហូតទាល់តែលឿង។

instructions.text: Stir in the strained prahok and the rest of the coconut milk; simmer to a thick dip.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់ប្រហុកដែលច្រោះរួច និងទឹកដូងដែលនៅសល់។ ដាំឱ្យក្រាស់ជាទឹកជ្រលក់។

instructions.text: Add diced eggplant and palm sugar; simmer until thick and glossy.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់ត្រប់ហាន់ និងស្ករត្នោត។ ដាំបន្តរហូតទាល់តែក្រាស់ និងភ្លឺ។

instructions.text: Serve warm with a generous platter of raw and blanched vegetables and rice.
instructions.textKm: បរិភោគក្ដៅៗ ជាមួយចានបន្លែស្រស់ បន្លែស្ងោរ និងបាយ។

recipes.descriptionKm: ប្រហុកខ្ទិះ — ទឹកជ្រលក់ប្រហុក ផ្សំជាមួយសាច់ជ្រូក និងទឹកដូងក្រាស់ បរិភោគជាមួយបន្លែស្រស់។

name.km: គុយទាវ

recipes.description: The iconic morning noodle soup: rice noodles in a clear pork-and-dried-seafood broth with all the toppings.

instructions.text: Simmer pork bones and dried squid 1–2 hours into a clear, sweet broth; skim often.
instructions.textKm: ដាំឆ្អឹងជ្រូក និងមឹកស្ងួត ១–២ ម៉ោង ឱ្យបានទឹកស៊ុបស្អាតផ្អែម។ ច្រោះញឹកញាប់។
instructions.tip: A clear broth is the mark of a good kuy teav — never let it boil hard.
instructions.tipKm: ទឹកស៊ុបស្អាត ជាសញ្ញានៃគុយទាវឆ្ងាញ់ — កុំឱ្យទឹកដាំរុះៗខ្លាំង។

instructions.text: Season the broth with rock sugar, salt and fish sauce.
instructions.textKm: បន្ថែមរសជាតិដោយស្ករអំពៅ អំបិល និងទឹកត្រី។

instructions.text: Cook the pork and shrimp toppings in the broth.
instructions.textKm: ដាំសាច់ជ្រូក និងបង្គា ក្នុងទឹកស៊ុបឱ្យឆ្អិន។

instructions.text: Blanch the noodles and bean sprouts; divide between bowls and add toppings.
instructions.textKm: ស្ងោរគុយទាវ និងសណ្ដែកបណ្ដុះ បន្ទាប់មកចែកដាក់ចាន ហើយដាក់គ្រឿងពីលើ។

instructions.text: Ladle over the hot broth; finish with fried garlic oil, herbs and lime.
instructions.textKm: ស្នូរទឹកស៊ុបក្ដៅពីលើ ហើយដាក់ប្រេងខ្ទឹមចៀន ស្លឹក និងក្រូចឆ្មារ។

recipes.descriptionKm: គុយទាវភ្នំពេញ — ភ្ញាក់ព្រឹកដ៏ល្បី គុយទាវក្នុងទឹកស៊ុបស្អាតពីឆ្អឹងជ្រូកនិងសុីហ្វូដស្ងួត ផ្សំជាមួយគ្រឿងគ្រប់យ៉ាង។

name.km: សម្លម្ជូរគ្រឿងសាច់គោ

recipes.description: A deeply aromatic sour soup of beef and lemongrass kroeung — a Khmer comfort-food classic.

instructions.text: Simmer the beef until tender, 45–60 minutes.
instructions.textKm: ដាំសាច់គោឱ្យទន់ ៤៥–៦០ នាទី។

instructions.text: Stir in the lemongrass kroeung and simmer until fragrant.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់គ្រឿងស្លឹកគ្រៃ ហើយដាំបន្តរហូតទាល់តែឈ្ងុយ។

instructions.text: Add tamarind, fish sauce and palm sugar; balance the sour-salty-sweet.
instructions.textKm: បន្ថែមអំពិល ទឹកត្រី និងស្ករត្នោត។ ដាក់ឱ្យរសជាតិសម — ជូរ ប្រៃ ផ្អែម។

instructions.text: Add the vegetables and simmer until just tender.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់បន្លែ ហើយដាំរហូតទាល់តែទើបទន់។

instructions.text: Finish with rice-paddy herb and sawtooth coriander; serve with rice.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់ម្អមនិងជីអង្កាមពីលើ បរិភោគជាមួយបាយ។

recipes.descriptionKm: សម្លម្ជូរគ្រឿងសាច់គោ — សម្លម្ជូរឈ្ងុយជាមួយសាច់គោ និងគ្រឿងលឿង ម្ហូបបោះតាមទម្លាប់របស់ខ្មែរ។

name.km: ឆាគ្រឿងសាច់មាន់

recipes.description: Stir-fried in fragrant yellow lemongrass kroeung — the soul of Khmer cooking.

instructions.text: Pound or blend the kroeung — lemongrass, galangal, turmeric, kaffir lime leaf, garlic and shallot — into a fragrant yellow paste.
instructions.tip: Pounding releases more aroma than blending, but a blender is fine.

instructions.text: Prepare the chicken: cut into bite-sized pieces.
instructions.textKm: រៀបចំសាច់មាន់៖ កាត់ជាដុំៗតូច។

instructions.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat until shimmering.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់ប្រេង ២ ស្លាបព្រាក្នុងខ្ទះ ហើយដុំឱ្យក្ដៅខ្លាំង។

instructions.text: Add the aromatics and stir-fry 1–2 minutes until fragrant and the raw smell is gone.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់គ្រឿងផ្សំ ហើយឆា ១–២ នាទី រហូតទាល់តែឈ្ងុយ និងបាត់ក្លិនឆៅ។

instructions.text: Add the chicken and stir-fry until cooked through and no longer pink, about 12 minutes.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់សាច់មាន់ ហើយឆា រហូតទាល់តែឆ្អិន ហើយបាត់ពណ៌ផ្កាឈូក ប្រហែល 12 នាទី។

instructions.text: Toss in yardlong beans and sweet pepper and stir-fry until tender-crisp.
Season with fish sauce, palm sugar and oyster sauce and a small splash of water; toss to coat.
Taste and adjust, then finish with holy basil and sliced fresh chili.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.
instructions.textKm: បរិភោគជាមួយបាយក្ដៅ។

recipes.descriptionKm: ឆាជាមួយគ្រឿងលឿង — ភាពឈ្ងុយឈ្ងប់ដ៏ប្រពៃណីរបស់ខ្មែរ។

name.km: ឆាគ្រឿងសាច់ជ្រូក

instructions.text: Add the beef and stir-fry until just browned but still tender, about 8 minutes.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់សាច់គោ ហើយឆា រហូតទាល់តែលឿងស្រាល តែនៅទន់ ប្រហែល 8 នាទី។

name.km: ឆាគ្រឿងសាច់ទា

recipes.description: Stir-fried in fragrant yellow lemongrass kroeung — the soul of Khmer cooking.

instructions.text: Pound or blend the kroeung — lemongrass, galangal, turmeric, kaffir lime leaf, garlic and shallot — into a fragrant yellow paste.

instructions.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat until shimmering.

recipes.description: The fiery 'cha kdav' — pounded chili and garlic with a forest of holy basil.

instructions.text: Pound the bird's-eye chili and garlic to a rough paste.

instructions.textKm: រៀបចំសាច់មាន់៖ កាត់ជាដុំៗតូច។

instructions.text: Mince the garlic and have the morning glory washed and cut.
instructions.textKm: កិនខ្ទឹមស ហើយលាង ត្រកួន ឱ្យស្អាតហើយកាត់រួច។

instructions.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat; fry the garlic until fragrant.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់ប្រេង ២ ស្លាបព្រាក្នុងខ្ទះ ហើយដុំឱ្យក្ដៅខ្លាំង។

instructions.text: Add the chicken and stir-fry until cooked through and no longer pink, about 12 minutes.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់សាច់មាន់ ហើយឆា រហូតទាល់តែឆ្អិន ហើយបាត់ពណ៌ផ្កាឈូក ប្រហែល 12 នាទី។

instructions.text: Add the morning glory and stir-fry over high heat until tender-crisp.
instructions.tip: Keep the heat high so the vegetable stays bright and never stews.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់ត្រកួន ហើយឆាលើភ្លើងខ្លាំង រហូតទាល់តែទន់និងក្រៀម។

instructions.text: Season with oyster sauce, fish sauce and a pinch of palm sugar; toss quickly.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.
instructions.textKm: បរិភោគជាមួយបាយក្ដៅ។

recipes.descriptionKm: ម្ហូបឆាដ៏លឿនជាមួយត្រកួន និងសាច់មាន់។

instructions.textKm: រៀបចំសាច់ទា៖ កាត់ជាដុំៗ។

instructions.text: Mince the garlic and have the bamboo shoot washed and cut.
instructions.textKm: កិនខ្ទឹមស ហើយលាង ទំពាំង ឱ្យស្អាតហើយកាត់រួច។

instructions.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat; fry the garlic until fragrant.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់ប្រេង ២ ស្លាបព្រាក្នុងខ្ទះ ហើយដុំឱ្យក្ដៅខ្លាំង។

instructions.text: Add the duck and stir-fry until tender, about 25 minutes.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់សាច់ទា ហើយឆា រហូតទាល់តែទន់ ប្រហែល 25 នាទី។

instructions.text: Add the bamboo shoot and stir-fry over high heat until tender-crisp.
instructions.tip: Keep the heat high so the vegetable stays bright and never stews.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់ទំពាំង ហើយឆាលើភ្លើងខ្លាំង រហូតទាល់តែទន់និងក្រៀម។

instructions.text: Season with oyster sauce, fish sauce and a pinch of palm sugar; toss quickly.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.
instructions.textKm: បរិភោគជាមួយបាយក្ដៅ។

recipes.descriptionKm: ម្ហូបឆាដ៏លឿនជាមួយទំពាំង និងសាច់ទា។

instructions.textKm: រៀបចំបង្គា៖ ចេញសំបក និងសរសៃ។

instructions.text: Mince the garlic and have the chayote washed and cut.
instructions.textKm: កិនខ្ទឹមស ហើយលាង ស៊ូ ឱ្យស្អាតហើយកាត់រួច។

instructions.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat; fry the garlic until fragrant.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់ប្រេង ២ ស្លាបព្រាក្នុងខ្ទះ ហើយដុំឱ្យក្ដៅខ្លាំង។

instructions.text: Add the shrimp and stir-fry until they curl and turn pink, about 5 minutes.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់បង្គា ហើយឆា រហូតទាល់តែបង្គាក្រឡុំ និងមានពណ៌ផ្កាឈូក ប្រហែល 5 នាទី។

instructions.text: Add the chayote and stir-fry over high heat until tender-crisp.
instructions.tip: Keep the heat high so the vegetable stays bright and never stews.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់ស៊ូ ហើយឆាលើភ្លើងខ្លាំង រហូតទាល់តែទន់និងក្រៀម។

instructions.text: Season with oyster sauce, fish sauce and a pinch of palm sugar; toss quickly.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.
instructions.textKm: បរិភោគជាមួយបាយក្ដៅ។

recipes.descriptionKm: ម្ហូបឆាដ៏លឿនជាមួយស៊ូ និងបង្គា។

instructions.textKm: រៀបចំសាច់ជ្រូក៖ ហាន់ជាបន្ទះស្ដើង។

instructions.text: Mince the garlic and have the ridge gourd (luffa) washed and cut.
instructions.textKm: កិនខ្ទឹមស ហើយលាង រនោង ឱ្យស្អាតហើយកាត់រួច។

instructions.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat; fry the garlic until fragrant.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់ប្រេង ២ ស្លាបព្រាក្នុងខ្ទះ ហើយដុំឱ្យក្ដៅខ្លាំង។

instructions.text: Add the pork and stir-fry until cooked through, about 12 minutes.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់សាច់ជ្រូក ហើយឆា រហូតទាល់តែឆ្អិន ប្រហែល 12 នាទី។

instructions.text: Add the ridge gourd (luffa) and stir-fry over high heat until tender-crisp.
instructions.tip: Keep the heat high so the vegetable stays bright and never stews.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់រនោង ហើយឆាលើភ្លើងខ្លាំង រហូតទាល់តែទន់និងក្រៀម។

instructions.text: Season with oyster sauce, fish sauce and a pinch of palm sugar; toss quickly.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.
instructions.textKm: បរិភោគជាមួយបាយក្ដៅ។

recipes.descriptionKm: ម្ហូបឆាដ៏លឿនជាមួយរនោង និងសាច់ជ្រូក។

recipes.description: A light, tangy clear soup brightened with lime and chili at the table.

ingredients.notes: cubed and lightly fried until golden

instructions.text: Prepare the tofu: cubed and lightly fried until golden.
instructions.textKm: រៀបចំតៅហ៊ូ៖ ហាន់ជាគូប ហើយចៀនបន្តិចឱ្យលឿង។

instructions.text: Bring stock to a boil with bruised lemongrass and galangal.
instructions.tip: Bruising or pounding the aromatics first lets them give up more flavour.

instructions.text: Add the tofu and simmer until heated through, about 6 minutes.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់តៅហ៊ូ ហើយដាំ រហូតទាល់តែក្ដៅ ប្រហែល 6 នាទី។

instructions.text: Add the vegetables (tomato, oyster mushroom, napa cabbage) and simmer until just tender.
Season with fish sauce and palm sugar, then balance with lime juice.
instructions.textKm: បន្ថែមទឹកត្រី និងស្ករត្នោត។

instructions.text: Taste — it should sing of salty, sweet and sour. Finish with coriander, chili and a final squeeze of lime.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.
instructions.textKm: បរិភោគជាមួយបាយក្ដៅ។

recipes.descriptionKm: ស្ងោរជ្រក់ — ស្រាល ជូរ ត្រជាក់ ដោយទឹកក្រូចឆ្មារ។

name.km: អាម៉ុកសាច់មាន់

recipes.description: Cambodia's signature dish — a silky coconut kroeung mousse steamed in banana leaf.

instructions.text: Pound the red kroeung to a very smooth paste — smoothness is everything in amok.
Prepare the chicken: cut into bite-sized pieces.
instructions.textKm: រៀបចំសាច់មាន់៖ កាត់ជាដុំៗតូច។

instructions.text: In a bowl, whisk the kroeung with coconut milk, egg, fish sauce and palm sugar until thick and creamy.
instructions.tip: Add the coconut milk a little at a time so the mixture emulsifies.

instructions.text: Fold in the chicken until well coated.
Line banana-leaf cups with a soft leaf, spoon in the mixture and top with coconut cream.
Steam over medium heat 20–25 minutes until set like a soft custard.
Garnish with coconut cream and shredded kaffir lime leaf; serve with rice.

recipes.descriptionKm: ការីអាម៉ុក — ការីចំហុយក្នុងស្លឹកចេក ផ្សំទឹកដូងនិងគ្រឿងលឿង។

name.km: ការីសាច់មាន់

recipes.description: A fragrant, lightly sweet coconut red curry — eaten with bread or rice noodles.

instructions.text: Fry the red kroeung and curry powder in coconut cream until aromatic and the oil splits.
Add the chicken (cut into bite-sized pieces) and brown lightly.
Pour in coconut milk and enough water to cover; add sweet potato and onion.
Simmer until until cooked through and no longer pink and the vegetables are tender, about 27 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and palm sugar.
instructions.textKm: បន្ថែមទឹកត្រី និងស្ករត្នោត។

instructions.text: Serve hot with crusty baguette or fresh rice noodles (num banh chok).

recipes.description: A rich, mild peanut-and-coconut curry of Cham–Khmer heritage, gently spiced.

instructions.text: Fry the red kroeung in a little coconut cream until the oil splits and it smells fragrant.
Stir in the ground roasted peanuts and toasted coconut.
Add the chicken (cut into bite-sized pieces) and seal in the paste.
Pour in the coconut milk and add the potato; simmer gently.
Simmer until cooked through and no longer pink and the potato is soft, about 27 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and palm sugar; it should be mild, nutty and rich.
instructions.textKm: បន្ថែមទឹកត្រី និងស្ករត្នោត។

name.km: ឆាក្រហមសាច់មាន់

recipes.description: A dry, intensely aromatic red-kroeung curry stir-fried until thick and glossy.

instructions.text: Fry the red kroeung in oil over medium-high heat until deeply fragrant and darkened.
Add the chicken (cut into bite-sized pieces) and stir-fry to coat in the paste.
Add a splash of coconut cream and the long beans; stir-fry until the sauce clings, about 12 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and palm sugar; cook until almost dry and glossy.
instructions.textKm: បន្ថែមទឹកត្រី និងស្ករត្នោត។

instructions.text: Finish with shredded kaffir lime leaf and sliced chili.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.

name.km: អាំងគ្រឿងសាច់មាន់

recipes.description: Charcoal-grilled chicken — lemongrass-marinated grill.

instructions.text: Blend lemongrass kroeung with fish sauce, palm sugar and a little oil into a marinade.
Coat the chicken (cut into bite-sized pieces) in the marinade and rest at least 30 minutes (overnight is better).
instructions.tip: Marinating overnight gives the deepest flavour and colour.

instructions.text: Light a charcoal grill and let it burn down to glowing embers (or heat a grill pan).
Grill the chicken over medium coals, turning and basting, until cooked through and no longer pink.
Serve with tuk meric — lime juice, salt, black Kampot pepper and chili.
Serve with steamed rice and fresh herbs and cucumber.

name.km: ញាំសាច់មាន់

recipes.description: A vibrant tossed salad of poached protein, crunchy vegetables and a forest of herbs.

instructions.text: Poach or grill the chicken (cut into bite-sized pieces) until just cooked, then slice thinly.
Whisk the dressing — lime juice, fish sauce, palm sugar, garlic and chili — until the sugar dissolves.
Combine the chicken with shredded cabbage, carrot, Asian basil & mint.
Pour over the dressing and toss well just before serving.
Pile onto a plate and top with extra herbs, peanuts and fried shallots.

Pour over the dressing and toss well just before serving.
Pile onto a plate and top with extra herbs, peanuts and fried shallots.

name.km: ភ្លៀត្រី

recipes.description: Thinly sliced protein 'cooked' in lime juice with lemongrass and herbs.

instructions.text: Slice the fish very thinly and toss with half the lime juice; leave 10 minutes until it turns opaque.
instructions.tip: Use only the freshest seafood/meat for a lime-cured pleah.

instructions.text: Whisk the dressing — lime juice, fish sauce, palm sugar, garlic and chili — until the sugar dissolves.
Combine the fish with lemongrass, shallot, sawtooth coriander & mint.
Pour over the dressing and toss well just before serving.
Pile onto a plate and top with extra herbs, peanuts and fried shallots.

name.km: គុយទាវសាច់មាន់

recipes.description: Cambodia's beloved breakfast noodle soup in a clear pork-and-dried-seafood broth.

instructions.text: Simmer the stock with dried seafood, rock sugar and a little fish sauce for 30 minutes; keep hot.
instructions.tip: Skim the broth often to keep it crystal clear.

instructions.text: Cook the chicken (cut into bite-sized pieces) in the broth until done; slice if needed.
Blanch the noodles and bean sprouts; divide between bowls.
Top with the chicken and ladle over the hot broth.
Finish with fried garlic oil, spring onion and coriander; serve with lime, chili and herbs on the side.

recipes.descriptionKm: គុយទាវ — ភ្ញាក់ព្រឹកដ៏ល្បីរបស់ខ្មែរ។

instructions.text: Cook the squid (cleaned and scored into rings) in the broth until done; slice if needed.

Finish with fried garlic oil, spring onion and coriander; serve with lime, chili and herbs on the side.

name.km: មីឆាសាច់មាន់

recipes.description: Wok-tossed yellow egg noodles with protein, vegetables and a savoury sauce.

instructions.text: Soak or loosen the noodles so they don't clump.
Heat a wok screaming hot; fry the garlic, then the chicken until cooked through and no longer pink.
Push aside, scramble the egg, then add the noodles and Chinese broccoli.
Season with oyster sauce, dark soy and a pinch of sugar; toss over high heat until smoky.
instructions.tip: Don't overcrowd — fry in two batches for proper 'wok hei'.

instructions.text: Add bean sprouts at the end, toss once and plate. Top with herbs and fried garlic oil.

recipes.descriptionKm: មីឆា — មីពណ៌លឿង ឆាជាមួយសាច់និងបន្លែ។

name.km: នំបញ្ចុកសាច់មាន់

recipes.description: Fresh fermented rice vermicelli under a lemongrass fish gravy, piled with raw herbs.

ingredients.item: banana blossom, cucumber, long beans & herbs

instructions.text: Pound the kroeung smooth and simmer in stock with strained prahok.
Add the flaked grilled fish (and your chosen chicken) and the coconut milk; simmer into a fragrant gravy.
Season with fish sauce and palm sugar to a savoury, slightly sweet balance.

Ladle the warm gravy over and pile high with raw banana blossom, cucumber, long beans and herbs.

recipes.description: Rice vermicelli in a rich, mildly spiced coconut-kroeung gravy.

instructions.text: Fry the red kroeung in coconut cream until the oil splits and it is fragrant.
Add the chicken (cut into bite-sized pieces), then the coconut milk and a little stock; simmer into a rich gravy.

Blanch the vermicelli into bowls and ladle over the coconut gravy.
Top with bean sprouts, herbs and fried garlic oil.

recipes.description: 'Dry' kuy teav — noodles tossed in a savoury sauce with the broth served on the side.

instructions.text: Soak or loosen the noodles so they don't clump.
Heat a wok screaming hot; fry the garlic, then the chicken until cooked through and no longer pink.
Push aside, scramble the egg, then add the noodles and Chinese broccoli.
Season with oyster sauce, dark soy and a pinch of sugar; toss over high heat until smoky.
instructions.tip: Don't overcrowd — fry in two batches for proper 'wok hei'.

instructions.text: Add bean sprouts at the end, toss once and plate. Top with herbs and fried garlic oil.

instructions.text: Soak or loosen the noodles so they don't clump.
Heat a wok screaming hot; fry the garlic, then the squid until just opaque (do not overcook).
Push aside, scramble the egg, then add the noodles and Chinese broccoli.
Season with oyster sauce, dark soy and a pinch of sugar; toss over high heat until smoky.
instructions.tip: Don't overcrowd — fry in two batches for proper 'wok hei'.

instructions.text: Add bean sprouts at the end, toss once and plate. Top with herbs and fried garlic oil.

recipes.descriptionKm: គុយទាវខ — គុយទាវខ្លាប់ ផ្សំជាមួយទឹកជ្រលក់។

name.km: ខសាច់មាន់

recipes.description: Slow-braised in a sweet-savoury palm-sugar caramel with coconut water.

instructions.text: Melt the palm sugar in a heavy pot until it caramelises to a deep amber.
instructions.tip: Take the caramel just to amber — too dark and it turns bitter.

instructions.text: Add the smashed garlic and the chicken (cut into bite-sized pieces); turn to coat in the caramel.
Add fish sauce and the braising liquid, plus the other aromatics.
Cover and braise gently until until cooked through and no longer pink and the sauce is syrupy, about 32 minutes.
Uncover and reduce until glossy and clinging.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.
instructions.textKm: បរិភោគជាមួយបាយក្ដៅ។

recipes.descriptionKm: ខ — ឆ្ងាញ់ផ្អែម ផ្សំជាមួយស្ករត្នោត និងទឹកដូងខ្ចី។

name.km: សម្លម្ជូរល្ហុងសាច់មាន់
name.en: Sour Soup with Green Papaya & Chicken

recipes.description: A bright Khmer sour soup of green papaya with chicken.

instructions.text: Bring the stock to a boil with bruised lemongrass and smashed garlic.
instructions.textKm: ដាំទឹកស៊ុបជាមួយស្លឹកគ្រៃបុក និងខ្ទឹមសបុក។

instructions.text: Add the chicken (cut into bite-sized pieces) and simmer until almost cooked.
Add the green papaya and simmer until tender.
Season with tamarind, fish sauce and palm sugar; balance to a clean sour-salty-sweet.
instructions.tip: Add tamarind gradually and taste — sourness should brighten, not dominate.

instructions.text: Finish with sawtooth coriander and rice-paddy herb; serve with rice.

recipes.descriptionKm: សម្លម្ជូរស្រស់ ផ្សំជាមួយល្ហុង និងសាច់មាន់។

recipes.description: A bright Khmer sour soup of taro stem with tofu.

ingredients.notes: cubed and lightly fried until golden

instructions.text: Bring the stock to a boil with bruised lemongrass and smashed garlic.
instructions.textKm: ដាំទឹកស៊ុបជាមួយស្លឹកគ្រៃបុក និងខ្ទឹមសបុក។

instructions.text: Add the tofu (cubed and lightly fried until golden) and simmer until almost cooked.
Add the taro stem and simmer until tender.
Season with tamarind, fish sauce and palm sugar; balance to a clean sour-salty-sweet.
instructions.tip: Add tamarind gradually and taste — sourness should brighten, not dominate.

instructions.text: Finish with sawtooth coriander and rice-paddy herb; serve with rice.

instructions.textKm: ដាំទឹកស៊ុបជាមួយស្លឹកគ្រៃបុក និងខ្ទឹមសបុក។

instructions.text: Add the clams (scrubbed) and simmer until almost cooked.
Add the sour leaf and simmer until tender.
Season with tamarind, fish sauce and palm sugar; balance to a clean sour-salty-sweet.
instructions.tip: Add tamarind gradually and taste — sourness should brighten, not dominate.

instructions.text: Finish with sawtooth coriander and rice-paddy herb; serve with rice.

recipes.descriptionKm: សម្លម្ជូរស្រស់ ផ្សំជាមួយស្លឹកម្ជូរ និងងាវ។

name.km: សម្លម្ជូរស្លឹកម្ជូរតៅហ៊ូ

name.km: បាយឆាសាច់មាន់

recipes.description: Wok-tossed Khmer fried rice with chicken.

instructions.text: Use cold, day-old rice and break up any clumps.
instructions.tip: Fresh rice turns mushy — day-old rice fries up separate and light.

instructions.text: Heat a wok very hot; fry the garlic, then the chicken until cooked through and no longer pink.
Push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the rice and onion; toss over high heat to coat and heat through.
Season with soy, oyster and fish sauces; toss until smoky and fragrant.
Finish with spring onion. Serve with sliced cucumber, lime and chili sauce.

name.km: បាយដំណើបស្វាយ

recipes.description: Fragrant coconut sticky rice served with mango.

instructions.text: Steam the soaked sticky rice over high heat 25–30 minutes until tender.
Warm the coconut milk with palm sugar, salt and pandan until the sugar dissolves (do not boil).
Fold most of the sweet coconut milk through the hot rice and rest 15 minutes to absorb.
instructions.tip: Keep a little coconut sauce back to spoon over at the end.

instructions.text: Serve the sticky rice with the mango and the reserved coconut sauce.

recipes.description: A creamy Cambodian street-style mango shake.

instructions.text: Add the mango, condensed milk, ice and a little syrup to a blender.
Blend until smooth and frothy; taste and adjust sweetness with a pinch of salt.
instructions.tip: A pinch of salt makes tropical fruit taste sweeter and rounder.

instructions.text: Pour into a tall glass and serve immediately over ice.

Blend until smooth and frothy; taste and adjust sweetness with a pinch of salt.

name.km: កាហ្វេទឹកដោះគោ

recipes.description: A classic Cambodian iced coffee with condensed milk.

instructions.text: Brew strong coffee using a phin or dripper.
Stir 2 tbsp condensed milk into the hot coffee.
Pour over a glass of ice and stir well.

recipes.descriptionKm: កាហ្វេទឹកដោះគោ — កាហ្វេក្ដៅខ្លាំង ផ្សំជាមួយទឹកដោះគោផ្អែម ហើយចាក់លើទឹកកក។

name.km: ទឹកអំពៅ

recipes.description: A classic Cambodian sugarcane juice.

instructions.text: Press the sugarcane through a juicer.
Squeeze in a kumquat or lime for brightness.
Serve very cold over ice.

recipes.descriptionKm: ទឹកអំពៅ — ស្រស់ត្រជាក់ ផ្អែមធម្មជាតិ ផ្សំជាមួយក្រូចសើច។

name.km: តែទឹកត្នោត

recipes.description: A classic Cambodian palm sugar iced tea.

instructions.text: Brew strong black tea and cool.
Sweeten with palm sugar syrup.
Serve over ice with a squeeze of lime.

recipes.descriptionKm: តែទឹកត្នោត — តែខ្មៅ ផ្អែមដោយស្ករត្នោត ផ្សំទឹកក្រូចឆ្មារ។

name.km: ទឹកដូងខ្ចី

recipes.description: A classic Cambodian young coconut water.

instructions.text: Open a chilled young coconut.
Pour the water over ice and scrape in the soft flesh.
Serve immediately.

recipes.descriptionKm: ទឹកដូងខ្ចី — ស្រស់ ត្រជាក់ និងផ្អែមធម្មជាតិ។

name.km: ទឹកក្រូចឆ្មារ

recipes.description: A classic Cambodian lime soda.

instructions.text: Squeeze fresh lime into a glass with syrup.
Add a small pinch of salt.
Top with soda water and ice.

recipes.descriptionKm: ទឹកក្រូចឆ្មារសូដា — ស្រស់ ត្រជាក់ ផ្សំអំបិលបន្តិច។

name.km: ទឹកអង្ករលីង

recipes.description: A classic Cambodian roasted rice tea.

instructions.text: Toast rice until deep golden and fragrant.
Simmer with pandan and a little rock sugar.
Strain and serve hot or iced.

recipes.descriptionKm: តែអង្ករលីង — អង្ករលីង ផ្សំជាមួយស្លឹកតើយ និងស្ករអំពៅ។

name.km: ទឹកអម្ពិល

recipes.description: A classic Cambodian tamarind juice.

instructions.text: Soak tamarind pulp in warm water and strain.
Sweeten and add a pinch of salt.
Serve cold over ice.

recipes.descriptionKm: ទឹកអម្ពិល — ផ្អែម ជូរ ត្រជាក់ លាយជាមួយស្ករ និងអំបិលបន្តិច។

name.km: ទឹកសណ្ដែក

recipes.description: A classic Cambodian soy milk.

instructions.text: Blend soaked soybeans with water and strain.
Simmer with pandan, skimming foam.
Sweeten and serve hot or cold.

recipes.descriptionKm: ទឹកសណ្ដែក — ទឹកសណ្ដែកសៀង ផ្សំជាមួយស្លឹកតើយ ផ្អែមៗ បរិភោគក្ដៅឬត្រជាក់។

name.km: នំបុ័ងប៉ាតេ

recipes.description: Cambodian baguette sandwich layered with pâté, pickles, herbs and chili.

instructions.text: Split a crisp baguette and toast lightly.
Spread with pâté and a swipe of butter.
Layer the sliced pork roll, pickled vegetables and cucumber.
Top with coriander, chili and a dash of soy; close and serve.

recipes.descriptionKm: នំបុ័ងប៉ាតេ — នំបុ័ងខ្មែរ លាបប៉ាតេ ផ្សំសាច់ បន្លែជ្រក់ និងម្ទេស។

name.km: សាច់ជ្រូកអាំង

recipes.description: Lemongrass-marinated pork skewers grilled over charcoal.

instructions.text: Marinate sliced pork in lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, palm sugar and honey.
Thread onto soaked skewers.
Grill over charcoal, basting, until caramelised.
Serve with rice or in a baguette.

recipes.descriptionKm: សាច់ជ្រូកអាំង — សាច់ជ្រូកប្រឡាក់ស្លឹកគ្រៃ អាំងលើភ្លើងធ្យូង។

name.km: នំកុយឆាយ

recipes.description: Pan-fried rice-flour cakes stuffed with garlic chives, served with a sweet-sour dip.

instructions.text: Make a soft rice-flour batter and steam into rounds with chopped chives.
Pan-fry until crisp and golden on both sides.
Serve hot with a sweet-sour fish-sauce dip.

recipes.descriptionKm: នំកុយឆាយ — នំម្សៅអង្ករ ផ្ទុកស្លឹកគុយឆាយ បរិភោគជាមួយទឹកជ្រលក់ជូរផ្អែម។

name.km: នំគ្រក

recipes.description: Crispy-bottomed, custardy coconut-rice cakes cooked in a dimpled pan.

instructions.text: Whisk rice flour, coconut milk, a little sugar and salt into a batter.
Heat a num krok pan and oil the wells.
Fill the wells and cook until the bottoms crisp and tops set.
Top with spring onion; serve warm in pairs.

recipes.descriptionKm: នំគ្រក — នំទឹកដូងស្រួយ ខាងក្នុងទន់ ដុតក្នុងថាសសម្បក។

name.km: នំចចេវ

recipes.description: Crispy fried rolls filled with pork, glass noodles and vegetables.

instructions.text: Mix the pork, soaked glass noodles, grated carrot and mushroom.
Roll tightly in wrappers, sealing with egg.
Deep-fry until golden and crisp.
Serve with lettuce, herbs and a sweet-sour dip.

recipes.descriptionKm: នំចចេវ — នំចៀនស្រួយ ផ្ទុកសាច់ជ្រូក មីស និងបន្លែ។

name.km: នំចារ

recipes.description: Soft rice-paper rolls of pork, shrimp, herbs and vermicelli with peanut dip.

instructions.text: Dip rice paper briefly to soften.
Layer lettuce, herbs, vermicelli, pork and shrimp.
Roll tightly, folding in the sides.
Serve with a peanut-hoisin dipping sauce.

recipes.descriptionKm: នំចារ — នំខ្ចប់ស្រួយ ផ្ទុកសាច់ បង្គា និងបន្លែស្រស់។

name.km: ចេកចៀន

recipes.description: Batter-fried bananas, crunchy outside and soft within.

instructions.text: Make a light batter with rice flour, sesame, a little sugar and coconut.
Coat the bananas.
Deep-fry until deep golden and crisp.
Drain and serve hot, optionally with palm-sugar syrup.

recipes.descriptionKm: ចេកចៀន — ចេកចៀន ខាងក្រៅស្រួយ ខាងក្នុងទន់។

name.km: ក្រឡាន

recipes.description: Sticky rice, black beans and coconut roasted inside a bamboo tube.

instructions.text: Mix soaked sticky rice with beans, coconut milk and salt.
Pack loosely into a bamboo tube lined with banana leaf.
Roast over charcoal, turning, until cooked and fragrant.
Peel back the bamboo and slice to serve.

recipes.descriptionKm: ក្រឡាន — បាយដំណើប សណ្ដែក និងទឹកដូង ដុតក្នុងបំពង់ឫស្សី។

name.km: នំចេក

recipes.description: Soft steamed cake of ripe banana, sticky rice and coconut.

instructions.text: Combine sliced banana with soaked sticky rice, coconut milk and sugar.
Wrap in banana leaf parcels.
Steam 30–40 minutes until set.
Cool slightly and serve.

recipes.descriptionKm: នំចេក — នំចំហុយ ផ្សំជាមួយចេក បាយដំណើប និងទឹកដូង។

name.km: បាយសាច់ជ្រូក

recipes.description: Cambodia's classic breakfast — grilled marinated pork over broken rice.

instructions.text: Marinate thinly sliced pork in garlic, coconut water and a little sugar.
Grill over charcoal until caramelised.
Serve over warm broken rice with pickled vegetables.
Add a small bowl of clear broth on the side.

recipes.descriptionKm: បាយសាច់ជ្រូក — ភ្ញាក់ព្រឹកដ៏ល្បី សាច់ជ្រូកអាំងលើបាយចំការ។

name.km: សង់ខ្យា

recipes.description: Silky steamed palm-sugar and coconut egg custard.

instructions.text: Whisk eggs with palm sugar until dissolved.
Stir in coconut milk and pandan extract.
Strain into a dish or hollowed pumpkin.
Steam gently until just set; chill before serving.

recipes.descriptionKm: សង់ខ្យា — សង់ខ្យាស្ករត្នោត និងទឹកដូងចំហុយ។

name.km: សង់ខ្យាល្ពៅ

recipes.description: Coconut-egg custard steamed inside a whole kabocha pumpkin.

instructions.text: Cut a lid in the pumpkin and scoop out the seeds.
Whisk eggs, palm sugar, coconut milk and pandan; strain.
Pour the custard into the pumpkin.
Steam 45–60 minutes until set; cool and slice into wedges.

recipes.descriptionKm: សង់ខ្យាល្ពៅ — សង់ខ្យាចំហុយក្នុងផ្លែល្ពៅ។

name.km: បបរ

recipes.description: Comforting rice porridge, plain or with chicken or fish.

instructions.text: Simmer rice in plenty of stock with ginger until broken down and creamy.
Season with fish sauce and white pepper.
Add cooked chicken or fish if using.
Top with spring onion, fried garlic and herbs.

recipes.descriptionKm: បបរ — បបរស្រូវឆ្អិន ផ្សំជាមួយសាច់ ឬ ត្រី បរិភោគក្ដៅៗ។

name.km: នំអន្សមចេក

recipes.description: Banana sticky-rice logs wrapped in banana leaf and boiled — a festival treat.

instructions.text: Season soaked sticky rice with coconut and salt.
Wrap around a banana and beans in banana leaf into a log.
Tie firmly and boil several hours.
Cool, unwrap and slice into rounds.

recipes.descriptionKm: នំអន្សមចេក — បាយដំណើប ផ្សំជាមួយចេក រុំស្លឹកចេក ហើយស្ងោរ។

name.km: នំគម

recipes.description: Pyramid-shaped sticky-rice dumplings with sweet coconut or savoury filling.

instructions.text: Make a soft glutinous dough.
Fill with sweet coconut-palm-sugar paste.
Shape into pyramids and wrap in banana leaf.
Steam until cooked through.

recipes.descriptionKm: នំគម — នំដំណើបរូបពីរ៉ាមីត ផ្ទុកសណ្ដែកផ្អែម រុំស្លឹកចេក ហើយចំហុយ។
